items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE portrait collectible game card border STYLE PROPOSAL, transparent reusable empty overlay, 1024x1536. Inputs 1-3 are drawing-style references ONLY: hand-painted anime illustration, broad opaque directional strokes, coherent simplified masses, grouped colored shadows, sparse expressive tapered contours, confident handmade edges. Do not copy their people, clothes, text or watermarks. Adapt this painting grammar to the frame. Border should be light and slender, quiet enough to support anime card art. Its continuous structural edge is approximately 18-24 pixels thick, with a few local accents. Keep a large rectangular central opening, roughly x90..934, y130..1455; decorative forms may project outward, only slightly into the opening. Mostly muted colored grays with richer color concentrated in a few small accents; selective drawing rather than tiny textures. Matte painted 2D forms. Avoid heavy armor, beveled metal, shiny gems, glossy 3D, ornate European filigree, roses, vines, dense micro-detail, triangular facet mosaics and all-over grain. Actual alpha transparency throughout the interior and exterior; no opaque background, haze or backing sheet. No card artwork, character, text, number, cost icon or UI. All frame parts contained inside canvas.
THEME: A lightly torn matte paper-and-ink frame with an editorial anime sketchbook feel. Four narrow pale warm-gray paper strips form a simple rectangle, a few irregular torn contour breaks and visible blunt painted overlaps. Two small muted indigo-blue paper tape tabs hold the upper left and lower right corners. A confident asymmetrical cobalt brush swipe crosses only the upper border near the right side, another short stroke accents the lower left. A few charcoal-blue ink marks describe folds and edge turns. Corners feel casual, handcrafted and crisp. Paper strips are only the border, never a full page behind the opening. No large illustration or busy scribbles; keep sides mostly calm.
items.note: 蓝色对角胶带 · 宽笔扫痕
